[USER] User is seeking advice on common mistakes to avoid when selecting cross training exercises.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Common mistakes to avoid when selecting cross training exercises include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Not considering individual fitness levels: Select exercises according to ability.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Overemphasizing one particular exercise: Select exercises that work different muscle groups and vary intensity.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Ignoring injury history: Select exercises that do not aggravate injuries and incorporate injury prevention exercises.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Relying solely on cardio exercises: Incorporate strength training exercises to maintain muscle mass.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Neglecting recovery: Incorporate rest days and recovery exercises like yoga or stretching.
